# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.3.2

Video reliability release.

## Highlights

- Fixes doorbell video startup by completing SIP/Flexisip and BT-AV media
  warmup during the explicit Home Assistant camera activation call.
- Keeps the native media bridge on-demand: no media worker unless Home
  Assistant requests the camera stream.
- Stops Flexisip again after the media session when the agent started it, so the
  device returns to a quiet idle state after viewing.

## Security and Privacy

- No credential, MQTT, firewall, QML, or device configuration changes are made
  by this release.
- The device agent still starts media only on explicit local API/RTSP demand.
